legal_principles.principle: A succession certificate is required to determine the dependents of a deceased person.
legal_principles.held: Unless and until the succession certificate is decided, the claim of the petitioner cannot be considered.

legal_principles.principle: A dependent is entitled to compassionate appointment.
legal_principles.held: The deceased during his life time, had two wives, namely, Radhabai and Samrin Bai. The petitioner's father had performed second marriage with Samrim Bai after death of his first wife and she being the elder daughter of second wife has applied for grant of compassionate appointment.
